ablation: Greedy/PSO x Huffman off/on x Bit Match off/on; greedy once and PSO five seeds = 864 runs. Same-source-message analysis plus identical-stream paired selector/Bit Match effects within each compression level.
timing: Measured wall time under four parallel image workers. PSO selection batched across five seeds and divided by five; cumulative prefix timings reused across conditions. Embed/decode exclude I/O and metrics. No standalone latency claim.

steganalysis.classifier: FLD ensemble, L=101, d_sub=200 fixed before evaluation, no test tuning
steganalysis.split: Leave one archive series folder out; all files of an image and all series siblings remain together; 4 folds sized 11,12,12,1; folders are proxy groups, not verified patient IDs
steganalysis.preprocess: Cover decoded JPEG and stego decoded lossless PNG, identical 512x512 grayscale arrays, no resize/augmentation
steganalysis.scope: Exploratory small-sample detection; no SRNet training or generalization claim
steganalysis.threshold: confidence > 0 predicts stego; ties assigned cover; AUC uses confidence ranks
steganalysis.report: Per-fold and pooled out-of-fold Accuracy, AUC, FPR, FNR, confusion matrices; ROC; all scores and splits saved

medical_validation: Verify files, JPEG properties, series grouping, duplicates, global metrics; clinical ROI/reader evaluation unavailable. Supplementary fixed central geometric ROI is explicitly nonclinical. No patient data or DICOM metadata inferred.
